title: FortKnight import document
description: What an importer — the person's own assistant reading a calendar, planner photo or export; the future Import page; scripts/build.py for a data set — hands the questionnaire (docs/importers.md). Version 2 is written for the person to read: `commitments` (repeats/start/lasts in words), untimed `tasks`, what was `skipped` and why, and a `review` summary; the app normalizes it on read. Version 1's machine sections (standingAppointments, fixedActivities, blockFocusGrid, appointmentBlocks, blocks, meals) stay valid in either version: the Assistant page merges standing appointments (and version-2 commitments) into the person's commitments (Startup 2), fixedActivities anchor the block split, blockFocusGrid (restricted to the profile's focus blocks) is what FortKnight's Overview shows, tasks land on the day pages; meals is reserved; mealPlan is the ForkKnife menu (docs/meal-plan.md).

schemaVersion.description: 1 = machine sections only; 2 = readable commitments/tasks/skipped/review (+ the machine sections).

commitments.description: Version 2: the person's timed commitments — appointments, lessons, work or school hours, meetings — one readable record each; merged into the person's commitments (Startup 2) on Apply.

repeats.description: "every week" · "every other week from YYYY-MM-DD" · "monthly on the 2nd tuesday" (1st-4th or last) · "monthly on day 15" · "once on YYYY-MM-DD"

items.description: A weekday name ("monday"), a 3-letter form ("Mon") or a plural ("Mondays") — case-insensitive.

weekdays.description: Required for "every week" and "every other week" (name the weekday even though the every-other-week date implies it); not needed for "monthly on the Nth <weekday>" (the phrase names it), "monthly on day N" or "once on <date>".

start.description: Optional for a task: a clock time when it has one ("7:00 PM"); otherwise use `when`.

lasts.description: Optional for a task: "10 min", "1 h" or integer minutes (default 0).

category.description: A categories.json key ("friends-family") or label ("Friends & Family").

from.description: Where it came from, for the reader: the source event's name, how many occurrences were seen, what was guessed.

tasks.description: Version 2: recurring things to do that have a day but no fixed clock time (chores, errands); shown on the day pages, never anchors.

repeats.description: "every week" · "every other week from YYYY-MM-DD" · "monthly on the 2nd tuesday" (1st-4th or last) · "monthly on day 15" · "once on YYYY-MM-DD"

items.description: A weekday name ("monday"), a 3-letter form ("Mon") or a plural ("Mondays") — case-insensitive.

weekdays.description: Required for "every week" and "every other week" (name the weekday even though the every-other-week date implies it); not needed for "monthly on the Nth <weekday>" (the phrase names it), "monthly on day N" or "once on <date>".

start.description: Optional for a task: a clock time when it has one ("7:00 PM"); otherwise use `when`.

lasts.description: Optional for a task: "10 min", "1 h" or integer minutes (default 0).

category.description: A categories.json key ("friends-family") or label ("Friends & Family").

from.description: Where it came from, for the reader: the source event's name, how many occurrences were seen, what was guessed.

when.description: Time of day for a task without a clock time; the day page places it in the block that word falls in (anytime = listed without a block).

skipped.description: Version 2: what the importer saw and did NOT bring in, each with the reason — so the person can judge completeness.

review.description: Version 2: the importer's summary for the reader — what was scanned (source, date range), counts found/imported/skipped, every guess made.

fixedActivities.description: Fixed activities in the shape of data/activities.json (id, title, dayKey, block, priority, categories, flexibility, timing). Timed ones with priority 1 or flexibility 'no' anchor the block split.

meals.description: Reserved: menu meals in the shape of data/menus/*.json.

mealPlan.description: The fortnight menu (docs/meal-plan.md), as the ForkKnife page writes it into the tasks document it creates: per meal, dishes with the day(s) they are eaten (the second day is leftovers). Applied into the profile's meal plan (merged by id) alongside the tasks.

leftoversMeal.description: The meal that eats the leftovers when not the same meal (name or slug).

blocks.description: The source system's day layout (informational; the same item shape as a weights file's blocks).

blockFocusGrid.description: The source system's focus per day and block. Keys are day keys (sun-a … sat-b); values map a focus block key to its focus.

appointmentBlocks.description: The block each day key opens for appointments in the source system.
